title: Spin the wheel
spinButtonHint: Spins the wheel and picks a random winner
tooManyLabels: Too many names to show on the wheel. See the full list below.

noEligible.title: No one left to pick
noEligible.message: Everyone has already won in this draw. Finish the draw, or allow repeat winners in settings.

complete.title: All winners selected
complete.message: This draw is complete. Finish it to save it to History.

empty.title: No participants
empty.message: Add participants to this project before spinning.

modal.heading: We Have a Winner!
modal.keepNote: {{name}} is off the wheel for the next spin.

settingsScreen.title: Draw Settings
settingsScreen.editParticipantsHint: Add, remove, reorder or edit names
settingsScreen.winnerCountHintExcluded: You can pick up to {{max, localeNumber}}. Each person can win once in this draw.
settingsScreen.winnerCountHintRepeat: You can pick up to {{max, localeNumber}} winners in one draw.
settingsScreen.winnerCountTooMany: That's more than the {{max, localeNumber}} people who can still win. Lower the number, or allow repeat winners.
settingsScreen.winnerCountTooFew: Winners already drawn: {{drawn, localeNumber}}. Choose at least that many.
settingsScreen.winnerCountInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
settingsScreen.repeatHint: A person can win more than once in this draw.
settingsScreen.repeatDisabledHint: Turned off while winners are removed from the list.
settingsScreen.removeHint: When you finish the draw, winners are deleted from this project's participant list. This is different from skipping them in later spins: it changes your list for future draws too.
settingsScreen.methodHint: Every person still on the wheel has exactly the same chance. The pick is made on your device, with no internet.
settingsScreen.applyNote: New rules apply to the remaining spins. Winners already drawn are kept.
settingsScreen.resetHint: Clears the winners picked so far and starts again with the current list. History is not changed.
settingsScreen.resetMessage: Winners picked so far in this unfinished draw will be cleared. Finished draws in History stay as they are.
settingsScreen.removeWarningMessage: After you finish the draw, the winners will be deleted from this project's list. History keeps its own copy.
settingsScreen.winnerCountAdjusted: Number of winners lowered to {{max, localeNumber}} to match the new rules.

sync.reset: The participant list changed, so this draw was restarted.
sync.detached: This project no longer exists. You can still finish the draw.

result.title: Draw Complete
result.heading: Winners
result.removedNote: {{count, localeNumber}} winners were removed from the participant list.
result.removedNoteOne: 1 winner was removed from the participant list.

errors.DRAW_COMPLETE: All winners have already been picked.
